title: On randomized batch-sampling coordinate descent methods for solving linear least-squares problems
summary: This paper refines randomized block coordinate descent by introducing a coordinate-level batch-sampling distribution characterization, yielding a fine-grained randomized batch-sampling coordinate descent framework, which applies to any block coordinate descent method under an arbitrary static stochastic sampling rule for solving large-scale linear least-squares problems. Based on this framework, we derive new linear convergence rate bounds that are invariant to the column scaling of data matrices.
